name: aisdlc-marketplace
description: AI-SDLC lifecycle plugins: aisdlc-dev for developers, aisdlc-design for UI/UX designers, aisdlc-qa for QA engineers and aisdlc-pm for project managers.

plugins.name: aisdlc-dev
plugins.description: AI-SDLC engineering lifecycle and governance plugin (developer side).

plugins.name: aisdlc-qa
plugins.description: AI-SDLC QA plugin (QA side): Jira ticket to approved scenarios, visible Playwright runs, defects on the ticket, signed-off evidence.

plugins.name: aisdlc-pm
plugins.description: AI-SDLC project-manager plugin (PM side): draft requirements and acceptance criteria and write them into the Jira ticket as the source of truth. Approvals stay human-only.
